$comment: A worked stock card under moving weighted average, computed by hand. Thirteen movements covering a receipt that re-averages, an issue that must not, freight capitalised with no quantity, a free sample that lowers the average, both kinds of return, both kinds of adjustment, an item that runs down to exactly nothing, and a receipt afterwards that must start a fresh average rather than carry the stale one. Changing the costing rule, the rounding, or the unit-cost scale must fail a test here.
$order: THE MOVEMENTS BELOW ARE DELIBERATELY NOT IN CARD ORDER. They are listed 5, 12, 1, 9, 3, 13, 7, 2, 11, 4, 10, 6, 8 — neither sorted nor reversed — while `expected.rows` is in date-then-sequence order. A fixture already in the answer's order cannot tell a sorted card from an unsorted one, and this project has shipped that test twice. Delete the sort in `runStockCard` and the very first row becomes an issue of 60 against an empty item, which the card refuses outright.

rows.why: 38750.00 x 40.000 / 150.000 is 10333.3333..., which is 10333.33 at money scale. THE AVERAGE WAS NOT RECOMPUTED — it drifts from 258.333333 to 258.333364 only because a third of a paisa could not leave, and the VALUE is what is right
inward freight capitalised onto stock already on hand: no quantity, and the average rises anyway
10 of the 60 sold, back at the cost they left at: 16154.55 x 10.000 / 60.000 is 2692.425, half-up to 2692.43. NOT at today's average
goods back to the supplier leave at the average, not at the price paid: 16154.55 x 5.000 / 60.000 is 1346.2125, down to 1346.21
free samples taken in at nil. Quantity rises, value does not, and the average FALLS from 269.24 to 197.44
shrinkage found at a count, valued like any other outward movement
the whole of what is on hand leaves at the whole of what it is worth. NO PAISA IS STRANDED: the value is exactly 0.00, and the unit cost of nothing is 0, not the last average and not NaN
THE AVERAGE RESETS. 320.00, not the 197.44 the item carried before it emptied
a stock-take surplus brought in at the current average leaves the average where it was
a fractional quantity: 10240.00 x 12.500 / 32.000 is exactly 4000.00

expected.$tie: 0.00 opening + 52882.43 in - 46642.43 out = 6240.00 closing. Asserted as literals, not as an identity over the rows, because an identity that holds by construction stays true when a whole row is dropped.
